name: Innovex Electric Kettle IEK008 (1.5L)
description: 1.5L Innovex stainless steel electric kettle with 1500W power and automatic shut-off. Fast boiling and safe for everyday use.
details: The Innovex IEK008 is a 1.5 litre stainless steel electric kettle designed for quick and convenient boiling. It features a high-quality stainless steel body and lid, anti-scalding handle, pull-up lid and a clear power indicator. The kettle automatically switches off once the water boils. Ideal for tea, coffee or daily kitchen use in Sri Lankan homes.
